```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("weather_df")
```

```{r}
weather_df
```

Make a scatterplot

```{r}
ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point()

```

Dataframe first

```{r}
ggp_temp_scatterplot = 
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()

ggp_temp_scatterplot
```

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) + 
  geom_point(alpa = .25) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)

# where you define your aesthetic matters, up to you
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpa = .25) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)

weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```

Faceting

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y= tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ name) # or (name ~ .)
```


```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y= tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  facet_grid(col = vars(name)) 
```


```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(aes(siz = prcp), alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(. ~ name)

```


Exercise
```{r}
# Do not change dataframe within ggplot

weather_df |>
  filter(name == "CentralPark_NY") |>
  mutate(
    tmax = tmax * (9/5) + 32,
    tmin = tmin * (9/5) +32
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_hex()
```


## Univariate plots 

Histogram
```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, fill = name)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "dodge") # or facet_grid(. ~ name)

```

Density plots

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, fill = name)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .3)
```

Boxplots

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = tmax)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```


Violin Plots

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = tmax)) +
  geom_violin()
```


Ridge Plots

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = name)) +
  geom_density_ridges()
```

## Save plots

```{r}
ggp_weather =
  weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = prcp), alpha = .5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ name)

ggp_weather


ggsave("images/ggp_weather.pdf", ggp_weather) # images subdirectory
```


```{r fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()
```
